text:
maria: Quick sync — need a decision on Q2 devex priorities. We have three competing asks: 1) JS SDK autopagination + typings, 2) 2x faster quickstarts for common flows (chat, embeddings), 3) a small sample app template for product teams. Customers are pressing for (1) and (3).

sam: +1 on native JS typings. A couple of enterprise customers blocked on TypeScript definitions for streaming + function calls.

tariq: Also hearing that sample apps reduce integration time from weeks to days. If we ship a polished mini-app that demonstrates hosted -> dedicated migration, it'll help sales.

jen: We need clear launch criteria. Proposed: (a) docs + sample app walkthrough, (b) automated CI example running the SDK tests, (c) a short playbook for migrating from API -> Dedicated.

arjun: From infra side, supporting autopagination requires a small change in our runtime paging recommendations (we recommend prefix caching). Does this change increase perf risk? Low. But we should add an integration test that simulates high-concurrency paging.

sam: Scope options:
- Minimal: provide typings + basic autopagination helper in JS SDK, no major runtime changes. Docs: 1 quickstart.
- Stretch: full autopagination that preserves token-level cost breakdowns + built-in batching hints. Docs: 3 quickstarts + sample app.

maria: Customer-driven priority ranking: 1) typings + autopagination (paid), 2) sample app (sales enablement), 3) expanded quickstarts (self-serve). But we only have 6 eng-weeks in the sprint. Need to choose minimal launch that still unblocks customers.

sam: Realistically minimal is ~3 eng-weeks for typings + helper + tests. Sample app is another 2 weeks if we reuse internal components. Quickstarts pro docs + recorded walkthrough maybe 1 week.

jen: Launch criteria proposal (single line each):
- "SDK: TypeScript types + autopagination helper released + integration test passing"
- "Sample app: 1 production-ready sample demonstrating chat + migration doc"
- "Docs: one canonical quickstart per flow with code snippets and a 5-min video"

maria: Risks/mitigations:
- Risk: autopagination hides cost signals -> Mitigation: docs + explicit opt-in and token-metered examples.
- Risk: sample app maintenance burden -> Mitigation: keep it <300 LOC, use Redwood SDK core only, add E2E smoke.

sam: Will prototype typings and autopagination helper this week. Plan to open a draft PR by Thu.

arjun: I'll add the integration test in eng-infra CI and reserve a small QA window for perf check.

tariq: I'll draft the sample app narrative and coordinate a 30-min walkthrough with sales next Wed.

maria: Decision: Move forward with Minimal + sample app as stretch if PR is green by Fri. If it slips, defer quickstarts to next cycle. I'll file the OKR ticket and owners.

docs-bot: Reminder — please attach PR links to the ticket and add the release checklist tag. :robot_face:

sam: Noted. PR link will go into #pr-triage and the ticket.

jen: I'll prepare the launch checklist (security review, deprecation notes, rollout plan) and share Monday.

maria: Awesome. Thanks all. Action items: sam -> PR, arjun -> CI test, tariq -> sample narrative, jen -> checklist. We'll reconvene next Tue 10am. :calendar:
